new: Back into the cell, after a review of v208: Remove from the relay shows only in the browser that put the network there, says it goes for everyone who uses it, and asks once.
Calls to the relay give up when it does not answer (The relay did not answer, with Try again) instead of waiting for ever.
A file with a very long line or field is refused at once (it could freeze the page); choosing a second file while the first is read keeps the second.
The relay: a refused share counts against the per-address limit, and the shared networks have a size cap (512 MB unless --nets-max says).
